text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is winding down. Including
our trip
to Hokkaido, it was a busy
summer to say the
least.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in the midst of it, Mejiro Palmer was
able to
discover that all she really wants
is to run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I love running! I wanna keep
running! Like,
from now on to forever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But do you think that's enough? I can't
help but
feel like it's not when I see her
like that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look in the direction Mejiro Palmer is
gazing at.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come. Long-distance
races
like the upcoming G1 Kikuka Sho
are my
specialty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will seize victory! And I will do the same at the spring Tenno Sho next year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like, McQueen's determination is on a
whole
other level. She's already won in
that department,
before she even steps
on the track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, I just like to run. I'm not
even sure if I
like racing yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I dunno if I belong out there with her,
running all
willy-nilly like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, there I go, overthinking again. My
poor
head can't handle all these
thoughts... Aaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This difference in passion for racing is
throwing
Mejiro Palmer for a loop.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Just, sorry. Once I get hooked on
something, I
can't really snap out of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I run 'cause I wanna, and that should be
enough,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I guess I've got way more angsty main
character
energy than I thought I did...
Sorry for being
difficult.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that she tends to be unconfident
and, as
she puts it, "angsty," but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oop, there you go, being all lenient and

accepting on me again. Seriously, it's
because
you're always so considerate
that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Meh, why not? I'll take all that
nonjudgmental
acceptance and support.
Anyway...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've got some figurin' out do to! I wanna
suss out
what it is I really wanna do.
